packages/db/src/lonora_db/pauses.py.name: Pauses store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/pauses.py.description: Records and lifts the pauses on an agent, a task, a routine or a watch, and keeps the owner's own pauses in force.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/peer_messages..name: Peer messages store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/peer_messages..description: Stores messages between agents, visible in both conversations.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/personal_agent.name: Personal agent
packages/db/src/lonora_db/personal_agent.description: Keeps the owner's one durable identity agent and finds the specialists for account events.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/push_devices.p.name: Push devices store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/push_devices.p.description: Registers and removes the owner's phones for push, dropping any whose sign-in was ended.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/reactions.py.name: Reactions store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/reactions.py.description: Sets and reads the quick reactions on messages.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/relationships..name: Relationship evidence store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/relationships..description: Saves and reads one kind of measured market-relationship evidence.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/rich_response..name: Rich content check
packages/db/src/lonora_db/rich_response..description: Checks a message's generated-UI content, falling back to plain text if it is malformed.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/routines.py.name: Routines store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/routines.py.description: Creates, schedules, enqueues and quarantines the owner's scheduled routines.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/run_retry.py.name: Retry a run
packages/db/src/lonora_db/run_retry.py.description: Re-runs a failed reply as a new run, respecting any wait the provider asked for.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/runs.py.name: Runs store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/runs.py.description: The store for agent runs: creating, claiming, leasing, checkpointing and projecting their outcome.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/schema.py.name: Database tables
packages/db/src/lonora_db/schema.py.description: Defines every database table and how each kind of record is stored.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/scratchpad.py.name: Scratchpad store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/scratchpad.py.description: Saves and reads an agent's scratchpad notes.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/search.py.name: Unified search
packages/db/src/lonora_db/search.py.description: Searches across chats, messages, tasks, files, knowledge and skills for the owner.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/secret_cards.p.name: Secret card store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/secret_cards.p.description: The Secret card: what it shows, where the owner's values are saved, and the run that follows.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/secrets.py.name: Secrets store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/secrets.py.description: Stores the owner's secrets by kind and refuses to delete one a connection still uses.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/skill_controls.name: Blocked skill versions store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/skill_controls.description: Records which skill versions the owner has blocked, per agent.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/skills.py.name: Skills store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/skills.py.description: Stores an agent's skills, keeping every saved version.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/steering.py.name: Steering store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/steering.py.description: Holds and delivers the owner's mid-run input to an agent.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/streaming.py.name: Reply streaming store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/streaming.py.description: Keeps the running preview of a reply as it is written.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/supervision.py.name: Lead actions store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/supervision.py.description: Records Lonora's actions steering a team agent's work: pauses, holds and each intervention.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/system_alerts..name: System alerts
packages/db/src/lonora_db/system_alerts..description: Wakes Lonora once for each system alert, such as a broker problem or an uncertain operation.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/task_recovery..name: Task recovery
packages/db/src/lonora_db/task_recovery..description: Retries a stuck task safely from its checkpoint, and hands it to the owner when it keeps failing.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/task_wait_sett.name: Task-wait commit
packages/db/src/lonora_db/task_wait_sett.description: Commits a task's wait and any owner update together.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/task_wait.py.name: Task wait & wake
packages/db/src/lonora_db/task_wait.py.description: Pauses a task until its condition is met and wakes it when it is.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/tasks.py.name: Tasks store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/tasks.py.description: The store for tasks: their steps, state, control and completion.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/telegram_pairi.name: Telegram pairing store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/telegram_pairi.description: Pairs the owner's Telegram chat with a bot using a one-time code.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/thread_prefs.p.name: Conversation state store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/thread_prefs.p.description: The owner's per-conversation state: read cursor, pins, archive setting and marks.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/threads.py.name: Conversations store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/threads.py.description: Creates and reads conversations and their options, and decides where a background run's records belong.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/tickets.py.name: Tickets store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/tickets.py.description: Saves and reads the owner's tickets.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/tool_usage.py.name: Tool recency store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/tool_usage.py.description: Remembers an agent's recently useful tools.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trade_approval.name: Trade approvals store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trade_approval.description: The store for trade approvals: pending, expired, decided, renewed or withdrawn.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_accoun.name: Trading accounts store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_accoun.description: Saves and reads the owner's trading accounts.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_decisi.name: Trading decisions store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_decisi.description: Keeps immutable snapshots of trading decisions and their history.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_journa.name: Trading journal store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_journa.description: Records each trade operation, from reservation to confirmed result, as the single source of truth.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_mode.p.name: Trading mode store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_mode.p.description: Stores and changes an agent's Full or Ask trading switch.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_opport.name: Opportunities store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_opport.description: Stores a trading opportunity's identity and its transition history.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_readin.name: Trading readiness
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trading_readin.description: Works out whether an agent can trade now and what is stopping it; a view only.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/transactions.p.name: Shared store helpers
packages/db/src/lonora_db/transactions.p.description: The shared building blocks the per-topic stores are built on, and the settings store.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/trusted_source.name: Trusted sources store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/trusted_source.description: The owner's trusted-sources list: add, remove, restore, and the reviewed tools of a connection.
